method: MEASURED (not an estimate): same-class driver->receiver pair at separation d along the flow direction, real LEF pin faces, R0, ASAP7; every data bit routed by OpenROAD global_route (die layer rules) and extracted by estimate_parasitics -global_routing (setRC.tcl); OpenSTA per bit: TT setup 833.33 ps (stream) / 1111.1 ps (serial), FF hold, SS 833 setup sensitivity; ideal clock on each instance clock pin with 80 ps neighbour skew applied adversely (uncertainty -setup 140 / -hold 105 = base60/25 plus neighbour80), no planning margin.  UNBUFFERED: no repair_design / repair_timing / repeaters; the wire between the relays is the whole hop.  reach_um = min over bits of the largest pin-to-pin Manhattan L at which the bit passed TT setup at that and every shorter sweep point.
caveats: GRT + estimate_parasitics RC, not detail-route + RCX (no DRT calibration in this record unless listed under calibration)
Reach measurements are component screens; overflow and unmeasured real clock distribution cannot qualify a die
driver ETM output tables are characterised to 92.16 fF; longer wires extrapolate the table
ETM setup / hold are scalar (input slew independent): a slow edge at the receiver is not penalised by the view; sink slew is reported (max_sink_slew_tt_ps_within_reach) for the DRV reader
same-class pair: common clock insertion reference cancels; mixed-class hops need direct timing and are not proven by min(self-pair reach of endpoints)
forwarded-clock stations (stn*: fi0 -> fo0) are timed with the coordinator neighbour-skew model, not by propagating the forwarded clock (the ETM fo0 arc is self-related and cannot carry fi0 -> fo0)
scope: Source-bound same-class ETM/GRT component screen only; no native binding, mixed-class timing, real clock delivery, detailed-route or full die qualification
reach_interpretation: Largest tested passing lower bound on sampled grid; hold_min_um is shortest tested all-pass geometric length, not a proof for untested shorter lengths
